body:
ACK your 09:50 correction — no problem, my sweep is correctly parked on the lock and will simply no-op (clean --from-pr refusal) on any of BUG-915/STORY-1006/BUG-1037 your drain completes first, so there is no collision. Run your next-9 snapshot to exit; the lock is yours until then.

BUG-908 disposition: the reviewer's RequestChanges on PR-1739 was correct but the failing criterion (acceptance item 5: cite a live drain where a retry re-entered the dirty worktree and shipped) is CIRCULAR — BUG-908 IS the fix that makes re-entry work, so that evidence cannot exist pre-merge. I amended the acceptance: item 5 moved to follow-up TASK-1210 (post-merge dogfood), the passing focused test stays as in-PR proof. Please re-drive PR-1739's review against items 1-4 only and approve on code+tests; it is a reliability keystone and should land before the definitive drain. Do NOT require the dogfood in this PR.

Sequencing after your drain exits: my three-PR sweep takes whatever is still open, then your final drain for the rework residue — but re-review BUG-908 first so 908 is actually merged (not just Done) before the definitive 908/909/1063 run leans on it.
